title: Charity auctions
intro: Bid on vouchers people have given up for a charity. The winning bid goes straight to the charity; YourTal never holds it.
teen: Charity auctions are for members 18 and over.
bidCount: {count, plural, =0 {No bids yet} one {# bid} other {# bids}}

yourStanding.outbid: You've been outbid. Your highest bid was {amount}.
yourStanding.won: You won with {amount}. The voucher is in your wallet.
yourStanding.lost: This auction ended. Your highest bid was {amount}, and your hold was released.

yourListing: This is your listing. You can't bid on it.
moneyPath: The winning bid is paid to the charity's own account. You get the voucher; the charity gets the money.

rules.reserve: The first bid must reach half the voucher's value.
rules.extension: A bid in the last 2 minutes adds 2 minutes, so nobody wins with a last-second bid.
rules.private: Only the amount and the number of bids are shown, never who bid.
rules.hold: Your bid places a hold on your card. It's only charged if you win, and released if you're outbid.

error.title: Auctions couldn't load
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No auctions open right now
empty.body: When someone lists a voucher for a charity, it shows up here.

empty.bids: You haven't bid on anything yet.
empty.listings: You haven't listed a voucher yet.

bid.label: Your bid ({currency})
bid.placed: Bid placed. You're the highest bidder.
bid.invalidAud: Enter an amount in dollars, like 21.50.
bid.invalidIdr: Enter a whole amount in rupiah, like 25000.
bid.fineprint: Bids are in cash and binding. Payments are simulated on this site.
